summary: Firefox adds and refines several web APIs: Request can stream uploads and expose response bodies as ReadableStreams, and Permissions Policy lets sites control which features embedded content may use. WebTransport gains statistics and a way to indicate support for reliable-only connections; WebGPU adds transient attachments for temporary rendering data. The work also updates WebRTC, the technology behind browser calls, improves Sanitizer API options, and aligns speech and SVG interfaces with web standards.
